name: tweet-buffer-workflow
title_zh: 草稿变已审帖，落进 Buffer 前先过你一道
tagline_zh: 喂素材，选改写模型，逐条审完再落 Buffer。Queue 或直发随你定，省掉复制粘贴和误发事故。
tagline_en: Feed material, pick a rewrite model, review each post, then drop into Buffer Queue or publish directly. No.
desc_en: Turn supplied material into reviewed X posts and prepare safe Buffer Draft, Queue, or direct-publish actions with selectable rewrite models.
why_zh: 把「改写—审核—排期」压成一条流水线，模型可换，落库前强制过目，不给你手滑直发的机会。
why_en: Compresses rewrite-review-schedule into one flow with swappable models and a mandatory human checkpoint before anything reaches.
limit_zh: 只处理文本帖，不含图片/视频上传；需自备 Buffer API token；改写质量取决于所选模型，不负责内容合规审查。
limit_en: Text-only posts; no image/video upload. Requires your own Buffer API token. Rewrite quality varies by model; no compliance review.
title_en: Turn raw notes into reviewed posts, staged safely into.
